items.text: Umpristi omkhulu wasesithi: Lembala lokhu kunjalo na?
UStefane wathi: Bobaba labazalwane, lalelani. UNkulunkulu wenkazimulo wabonakala kubaba uAbrahama eseMesopotamiya, engakakhi eHarani,
Gen 12:1
wathi kuye: Suka elizweni lakini lasezihlotsheni zakho, uye elizweni engizakukutshengisa lona.
Wasesuka elizweni lamaKaladiya, wakha eHarani. Kwathi ngemva kokufa kukayise, uNkulunkulu wamsusa lapho, wamhlalisa kulelilizwe elakhe kilo lina.
Kodwa kamnikanga ilifa kilo, ngitsho lelingangonyawo, kodwa wathembisa ukumnika lona libe ngelakhe lelenzalo yakhe emva kwakhe, lanxa wayengakabi lamntwana.
Gen 12:7
UNkulunkulu wakhuluma kanje, wathi: Inzalo yakho izakuhlala elizweni labanye abazakuyenza izigqili, bayiphathe kubi iminyaka engamakhulu amane.
Kodwa lesosizwe abazakuba yizigqili kuso ngizakusilahla mina, kutsho uNkulunkulu; emva kwalokho bazakuphuma, bangikhonze kulindawo.
Wasemnika isivumelwano sokusoka; ngakhoke uAbrahama wazala uIsaka, wamsoka ngosuku lwesificaminwembili; uIsaka wazala uJakobe, uJakobe wazala okhokho abalitshumi lambili.
Okhokho babelomona ngoJosefa, bamthengisa eGibithe; kodwa uNkulunkulu wayelaye,
wamkhulula kuzo zonke inhlupheko zakhe, wamnika umusa lokuhlakanipha phambi kukaFaro inkosi yaseGibithe; yena wamenza abe ngumbusi weGibithe lowendlu yakhe yonke.
Kwasekufika indlala elizweni lonke laseGibithe lelaseKanani, lokuhlupheka okukhulu; okhokho baswela ukudla.
Gen 42:1
UJakobe esezwile ukuba kukhona amabele eGibithe, wathumela okhokho okokuqala.
Ngokwesibili uJosefa waziveza kubafowabo; labakibo kaJosefa babonakaliswa kuFaro.
Gen 45:1
UJosefa wasethumela ukubiza uyise uJakobe lazo zonke izihlobo zakhe, abantu abangamatshumi ayisikhombisa lanhlanu.
Gen 45:9
UJakobe wehlela eGibithe; wafela khona yena labokhokho.
Bathwalelwa eShekema, bangcwatshwa khona elibeni uAbrahama ayelithenge ngemali yesiliva kumadodana kaHamori eShekema.
Josh 24:32
Kwathi sesisondele isikhathi sesithembiso uNkulunkulu ayesenze kuAbrahama, banda abantu, baba banengi eGibithe,
Eks 1:7
kwaze kwavela enye inkosi eGibithe eyayingamazi uJosefa.
Yona yasiphatha ngobuqili isizwe sakithi, yabahlupha okhokho ngokubalahlisa abantwana babo ukuze bangaphili.
Eks 1:10
Ngalesosikhathi kwazalwa uMose, waba muhle phambi kukaNkulunkulu; wondliwa endlini kayise inyanga ezintathu;
Eks 2:2
eselahliwe, indodakazi kaFaro yamthola, yazondlela yena ukuba abe yindodana yayo.
UMose wafundiswa konke ukuhlakanipha kwamaGibithe; waba lamandla ngamazwi langemisebenzi yakhe.
Kwathi eseleminyaka engamatshumi amane ezelwe, kwafika enhliziyweni yakhe ukuba ahambele abafowabo, abakoIsrayeli.
Wabona omunye wabo ephathwa kubi, wamvikela ekuhlutshweni ngokutshaya umGibithe, wambulala.
Wayethemba ukuba abafowabo bazaqedisisa ukuthi uNkulunkulu ubanika inkululeko ngesandla sakhe; kodwa kabaqedisisanga.
Ngosuku olulandelayo wafica ababili besilwa, wazama ukubalamula, wathi: Madoda, lingabazalwane; liphathanelani kubi na?
Kodwa lowo owayemona umakhelwana wakhe wamsunduza esithi: Ubekwe ngubani ukuba ube ngumbusi lomthonisisi phezu kwethu na?
Usufuna ukungibulala lami, njengokuba ubulele umGibithe izolo na?
Ngenxa yalamazwi uMose wabaleka, waba ngowezizwe elizweni laseMidiyani, lapho azala khona amadodana amabili.
Eks 18:3
Kwathi sekudlule iminyaka engamatshumi amane, kwabonakala kuye enkangala yasentabeni iSinayi isithunywa phakathi kwelangabi lomlilo esihlahleni.
Kwathi uMose esekubonile wamangala; esasondela ukuba acinge, kwezwakala ilizwi leNkosi, lathi:
NginguNkulunkulu wabokhokho benu, uNkulunkulu kaAbrahama lokaIsaka lokaJakobe. UMose wathuthumela, kazaba lesibindi sokukhangela.
INkosi yathi kuye: Khumula amanyathelo enyaweni zakho, ngoba indawo omi kiyo ingumhlabathi ongcwele.
Ngikubonile impela ukuhlutshwa kwabantu bami abaseGibithe, ngizwile ukububula kwabo; ngehlile ukuba ngibakhulule. Wozake, ngizakukuthuma eGibithe.
UMose lo abamalayo besithi: Ubekwe ngubani ukuba ube ngumbusi lomthonisi na? — nguye uNkulunkulu amthumayo ngesandla sesithunywa esabonakala kuye esihlahleni, ukuba abe ngumbusi lomkhululi.
Yena lowo wabakhupha esenze izimangaliso lezibonakaliso eGibithe, lasoLwandle oluBomvu, lasenkangala iminyaka engamatshumi amane.
Eks 7:5
Nani 14:33
Nguye lowo uMose owathi kwabakoIsrayeli: UNkulunkulu uzakulivusela umprofethi kubazalwane benu onjengami.
Dute 8:15
Nguye lowo owayesebandleni enkangala kanye lesithunywa ekhuluma laso entabeni iSinayi kanye labokhokho, wamukela amazwi okuphila, ukuze asinike thina.
Dute 5:1–33
Okhokho kabavumanga ukumlalela, kodwa bamsunduzela eceleni, babuyela eGibithe ngenhliziyo zabo,
bathi kuAroni: Senzele onkulunkulu abazakuhamba phambi kwethu; ngoba uMose lowo owasikhupha elizweni laseGibithe, kasazi ukuba wehlelwe yini.
Eks 32:1
Benza ithole ngalezonsuku, baletha umhlatshelo esithombeni, bajabula ngemisebenzi yezandla zabo.
Kodwa uNkulunkulu wabafulathela, wabanikela ukuba bakhonze izinkanyezi, njengokulotshiweyo encwadini yabaprofethi ukuthi:
Okhokho babelalo ithente lobufakazi enkangala njengokulayela kwalowo owakhuluma kuMose ukuba alenze ngomfanekiso ayewubonile;
Eks 25:9
okhokho kanye loJoshuwa balamukela balingenisa elizweni lezizwe uNkulunkulu azixotsha phambi kwabo, lalikhona kwaze kwaba sensukwini zikaDavida.
Yena wafumana umusa emehlweni kaNkulunkulu, wacela ukuzuzela uNkulunkulu kaJakobe idumba.
Kodwa nguSolomoni owamakhela indlu.
Kanti oPhezukonke kahlali ezindlini ezenziwe ngezandla njengokutsho komprofethi ukuthi:
Lina abanhliziyo ezilukhuni, abangasokanga enhliziyweni lasendlebeni, limelana njalo loMoya oNgcwele; njengabokhokho benu linjalo lani.
Nguwuphi owabaprofethi okhokho benu abangamzingelanga na? Bababulala labo abamemezela ngaphambili ukuza koLungileyo, eselimnikele lambulala,
lina elamukela umlayo ngokulaya kwezithunywa, kodwa kaliwulondolozanga.
Bathi sebezwile lezizinto, bahlabeka enhliziyweni, bamgedlela amazinyo.
Kodwa yena egcwele uMoya oNgcwele wajolozela ezulwini, wabona inkazimulo kaNkulunkulu, loJesu emi ngakwesokunene sikaNkulunkulu,
wathi: Khangelani, ngibona izulu livulekile, leNdodana yomuntu imi ngakwesokunene sikaNkulunkulu.
Kodwa bamemeza ngelizwi elikhulu, bavala indlebe zabo, bonke batheleka phezu kwakhe,
basebemkhuphela ngaphandle komuzi, bamkhanda ngamatshe. Ofakazi babeka ingubo zabo ngasenyaweni zensizwa ethiwa nguSawuli.
Bamkhanda ngamatshe uStefane ekhuleka esithi: Nkosi Jesu, yamukela umoya wami.
Waseguqa phansi, wamemeza ngelizwi elikhulu, esithi: Nkosi, ungababaleli lesisono. Esetshilo lokhu wafa.
USawuli wayevumelene labo ngokubulawa kwakhe.
